actual_review_units.behavior: Resolved views own cell vectors. Victim snapshots preserve exact sequence memberships, metadata, shift, payload generation and separate hot-pool/store presence; factored rows need store tracking even when absent from the hot pool.

Declares per-logical-layer storage introspection without tensor views and preflight/commit split for hot release. Gate under store lock may take the pool lock but must make no store calls; validation is outside that lock. Declared no-mutation rejection depends on implementations, not this header alone.

Synchronization boundary for compaction; Turbo shifts require real phase transform and requantization. Preflighted victim collection defers old-row release until successful compute; failure rolls back store/pool/cells/victims, with combined failure status rather than silent continuation. Shared payload release is deduplicated; removal gate is pool-only under the store lock.

fp_bump actually increments only when activated; unsigned increment has no special saturation. RERoT world has per-owner validity/generation, lazy per-sequence ownership columns and reusable scratch. Meta refresh catches an escaping update and invalidates the world; invalid worlds reject incremental updates pending rebuild.

Actual declaration order places runtime owner before context buffers, consistent with buffers destructing first. Shared pointers co-own store/runtime/coordinator across aliases; a per-device executor map avoids rebuilding ownership objects per row. Custom owner destructor and initialization bodies are outside selected/supplied text.

Declares factored-state trailers only where required, zero extra bytes for OFF/PARTIAL_ONLY. Context owns reservations, victim/outcome records and batches; exactly-once postcompute outcome is declared. Layout key uses owned batch, role and capacity plus owner stamps; false can mean policy-ineligible or hard error and freshness must be checked before reuse.

behavior: Per-layer introspection and materialization boundaries.
Explicit preflight/commit/rollback and hot/store lifetime separation.
Opt-in per-owner mutation stamps, cache invalidation and scratch reuse.
Shared coordinator ownership for aliased caches and device executor reuse.
Versioned factored-state trailer boundary and owned-batch layout cache.
dependencies: Private llama memory, batch, KV-cell, RERoT world, TriAttention and XKV types plus GGML tensors/backends.
Most substantive mutations are declared here and implemented in src/llama-kv-cache.cpp or XKV runtime; those bodies were outside this eight-file request.
No public standalone C can provide these physical KV ownership semantics solely by wrapping ordinary completion requests.

retention_candidates.boundary: B plan/cache values plus focused A metadata-mutation and graph consumption hooks
retention_candidates.required_contract: Owner stamps must advance on all relevant mutations; source batch storage must remain owned; OFF branch and invalid-world fallback must be retained.

reviews.read_scope: 仅下面实际范围：接口、首尾实现或选定完整短函数/文档片段；其余行未进行逐行内容审查。
reviews.range_line_basis: 旧 fork diff 的 new-side 文件行号
reviews.behavior: 逻辑 bytes、padded bytes、实际 unique allocation bytes 分开；清空先检 epoch/reserve，再 retire 不可变段；report 按 allocation ID 去重。；hot deficit 只由热槽减少满足，store deficit 按 factored bytes，recurrent 压力独立；mutation 成功后才使相关 landmark 失效。
private_dependencies_and_abc_boundary: immutable ownership/元数据可 B；实际 GGML buffer、cells、内容/绑定 epoch 为私有 A 体系。
单位和计划可 B，实际删除语义仍由 A cells/store 执行。

actual_review_units.behavior: Sampled token bytes can split structure anywhere; the entire token remains pending if a suffix could be an opener/close marker. A step tells the real KV consumer to publish/reclassify atomically after decode. Snapshot values own partial bytes and items. Restore declares invariant validation and explicit failure, not repair.

Zero limits are unbounded and exceeded limits abort the episode, not a child. Token plan inline checks valid run/nonnegative storage/non-normal visibility. Per-lane newline assembler owns blocked segments and partial lines; pending stalls only that lane, private newlines never form external boundaries, finish emits a visible remainder with one newline.

Fence completion requires prepared/nonempty/exact cursor. Prebranch validity is an explicit captured flag plus valid sequence/watermark; clear resets all fields. Sampler seed/history is opaque validation data and explicitly cannot restore standalone RNG/grammar/adaptive continuity. Routing distinguishes streaming incompleteness from final invalid data; parser must reject graph defects. Node control_id borrows bytes from owned marker rather than storing a second mutable identity.

Owned episode state separates logical document/queue/epochs from physical slots; root response ownership is explicit. Research fixed-entry text must not silently replace a lossless live chat-template boundary. Episode counters include public/private/forced/pending tokens and immutable plan-kind distinction.

Pen scheduling declares age-first one-per-person then round-robin admission; no scheduling inside per-row completion. Simultaneous exit order is stable. Physical lane and internal parked/archive/probe ID spaces are disjoint by the stated arena contract. Save/load and demotion preserve logical state; methods depend on actual runtime implementation.

Little-endian logical episode wire with version/caps/model-RoPE-Tri identity, topology/parser validation and untouched output on failed load; no physical tensor bytes or virtual position serialization. Sampler blob validator has no standalone decoder. Public-run truncation keeps base prefix, frame and live dependencies. Context envelope must pair with logical tree and real view reinstall before decode.

Maps exact streamed chronicle order back to canonical document reasoning for a following turn. Unknown/tampered/edited reasoning is declared to return nullopt rather than guess a match. Actual map implementation/collision/lifetime policy is outside this header pass.

Exact checkpoint and sampler continuity boundary.
Routing incompleteness versus invalidity, stable scheduler and execution-ID ownership.
Versioned logical persistence, pinned public-run truncation, explicit root response owner.
Strict chronicle-to-canonical history mapping.
